Rotko Networks

Official F-Droid repository of Rotko Networks. Ships Zafu Zigner, the air-gapped Zcash, Penumbra and Substrate hardware signer, built and signed by Rotko Networks.

Currently it serves 1 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://foss.rotko.net/fdroid/repo
